description: Find open sales roles (SDR and BDR, account executive, account manager, customer success, sales engineering, sales leadership and more) at the 3241 companies whose careers systems SalesJobs.Now reads. Each result gives the title, the hiring company, the kind of sales work, the posted pay, the location and a link to the role on SalesJobs.Now, where the user applies. Every filter is optional. Use it when the user wants actual roles to read or apply to, including roles above a pay floor (min_pay_usd). For what a kind of sales role pays in general use get_sales_pay, and for how many roles are open by kind or company use get_sales_market.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (for example 'US', 'GB', 'CA'); keeps the roles open to people in that country.

kind.description: One kind of sales work, given as one of the listed slugs.

limit.description: Number of roles to return, from 1 to 25.

min_hourly_usd.description: The same floor given per hour, multiplied by 2,080 hours to make a year. Prefer min_pay_usd unless the user asked for an hourly rate.

min_pay_usd.description: Keeps roles whose posted pay reaches at least this many US dollars a year at the top of its range, for example 150000 for $150k base or OTE. A posting quoted per hour is counted at 2,080 hours a year.

platform.description: One hiring company by its slug; get_sales_market lists every company with open roles and its slug.

query.description: Words to look for in a role's title or place, for example 'enterprise account executive', 'SDR', 'medical device', 'Dallas', 'Texas' or 'remote'. Put a city, state or 'remote' here when the user names one.

name: search_sales_jobs
title: Search sales jobs
